method: Use unseasoned mince made from 100% skinless turkey breast, weighed raw. Commercial mixed-cut turkey mince is not the specified ingredient; ask the butcher for breast mince or mince skinless breast at home.

Weigh the individual pizza base before cooking, using the raw weight listed in the ingredients. Preheat the oven to the temperature stated on its packet. Put a baking tray inside to heat. Keep the base ready on a board; follow any packet instruction to pre-bake it, and use its stated baking time for the final oven stage.
Slice the mixed peppers thinly. Heat half of the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and cook the peppers for 5–6 minutes until softened; transfer them to a clean bowl.

Keep the turkey breast mince ready to break into small pieces in the pan. Coat with all the measured paprika, chilli powder, garlic powder and dried oregano. After handling raw turkey breast mince, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Add the remaining half of the measured olive oil to the non-stick frying pan. Cook the turkey breast mince over a medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes, breaking up clumps and stirring frequently. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must stay at 75°C or above for 30 seconds. Without a thermometer, cut the thickest piece open and check that it is steaming inside with no pink meat. Continue cooking until these checks are met; the suggested pan time alone is not a safety check.

Transfer the cooked turkey breast mince to the bowl of peppers. Add the measured tomato passata to the empty frying pan and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened so it will not soak the base.

Spread all the thickened tomato passata over the individual pizza base, leaving a narrow border. Arrange the cooked peppers and the cooked turkey breast mince evenly on top. Carefully slide onto the hot tray.
Bake for the pizza base packet's stated time, until the dough is cooked through, the base is crisp underneath and the topping is hot throughout. Rest for one minute, cut and serve.

review.notes: Cooked turkey-mince crumbles, softened mixed peppers and thickened passata on a golden individual baked pizza base; dried spices cooked into topping, no cheese. Believable single serving with central composition and crop margin.
review.alt: Spiced turkey and mixed pepper pizza with tomato sauce.
